scope: post-freeze diagnostics on already-opened front-only holdout

cnn_optimizer_cross.scope: post-freeze holdout diagnostic; not used for selection

spectral_feasibility_upper_bound.statement: Each reported value is a valid spectral upper bound for any unit-norm complex weight, hence also for phase-only constant-modulus weights. Optimization of alpha tightens the bound but is not required for validity.

coordinate_relationship.interpretation: Angular separation is expected to relate more directly to normalized feasibility; absolute gain also contains the direction-dependent single-point ceiling.

strong_field_diagnostic.definition: A point is strong when its realized gain is at least 0.1 of its own single-point numerical ceiling, equivalent to within 10 dB.

hemisphere_relative_diagnostic.definition: rho_i(w)=G(q_i,w)/max_{q_x>0}G(q,w), where the denominator is scanned on the combined 32,400-direction one-degree HFSS front grid.
